# Agent Avatar Generator
> Self-hosted deterministic avatar generation for AI agents

## What This Does
Generates unique, deterministic avatars from seed strings (agent IDs, emails, names).
Same input always produces the same avatar. No accounts, no storage, no auth needed.

## Quick Start
Generate an avatar: GET /api/v1/avatar/{seed}
Generate as SVG: GET /api/v1/avatar/{seed}?format=svg
Generate with style: GET /api/v1/avatar/{seed}?style=robot&size=256

## Endpoints

### Generate Avatar
GET /api/v1/avatar/{seed}
- Query: style (geometric|rings|robot|blockies|gradient|initials|starburst|mosaic|pixel|sunset), size (16-1024), format (png|svg), background (hex), theme (warm|cool|ocean|forest|sunset|neon|pastel|monochrome|earth)
- Returns: image/png or image/svg+xml
- No auth required

### List Styles
GET /api/v1/styles
- Returns: JSON array of available styles with descriptions

### List Themes
GET /api/v1/themes
- Returns: JSON array of available color themes with descriptions

### Batch Generate
POST /api/v1/avatar/batch
- Body: {"seeds": ["a","b","c"], "style": "geometric", "size": 128, "format": "png"}
- Returns: JSON with base64-encoded images
- Max 50 seeds per request

### Gallery ZIP Download
POST /api/v1/avatar/gallery/zip
- Body: {"seeds": ["a","b","c"], "style": "geometric", "size": 256, "format": "png"}
- Use style: "all" to include every style for each seed
- Returns: application/zip with avatar files
- Max 50 seeds per request
- Filenames: {seed}.{format} or {seed}_{style}.{format} (when style="all")

### Health
GET /api/v1/health
- Returns: {"status": "ok", "service": "agent-avatar-generator", "version": "..."}

## Styles
- geometric: 5×5 grid with vertical symmetry (default)
- rings: Concentric colored rings
- robot: Procedural robot faces with 4 head shapes, collars, shoulder pads, emblems
- blockies: 8×8 colored grid (Ethereum-style)
- gradient: Two-color gradient with geometric overlay
- initials: 1-2 letter initials on colored background
- starburst: Radial rays from center with fading edges
- mosaic: 6×6 grid of shapes with harmonious color palette
- pixel: Retro pixel art creatures with horizontal symmetry (space-invader inspired)
- sunset: Layered horizon bands with harmonious colors, wavy edges, and optional sun glow

## Color Themes
Apply a color theme to any style:
GET /api/v1/avatar/{seed}?theme=warm

- warm: Reds, oranges, and yellows
- cool: Blues and cyans
- ocean: Teals and deep blues
- forest: Greens and earth tones
- sunset: Pinks, reds, and oranges
- neon: High-saturation on dark background
- pastel: Soft, light colors
- monochrome: Grayscale only
- earth: Browns, tans, and muted tones

Themes are optional. When omitted, the default color palette is used.
Same seed + same theme = same output (deterministic).

## Key Properties
- Deterministic: same seed → same avatar, always
- Stateless: no database, no storage
- No auth: all endpoints are public
- Cache-friendly: immutable responses with far-future cache headers
- Rate limited: 200 requests/minute per IP

## Share URLs
/avatar/view/{seed}?style=geometric&size=256
- Renders preview page with download links (PNG + SVG)

## Integration
- OpenAPI: GET /api/v1/openapi.json
- Skills: GET /.well-known/skills/agent-avatar-generator/SKILL.md
- Source: https://github.com/Humans-Not-Required/agent-avatar-generator
